# Register reference {#registers}

This appendix lists the registers of the USB 3 cores that a bench target exposes on its
CSR bus. It is generated from the register definitions of the gateware, elaborated on two
bench configurations without running an FPGA toolchain. Offsets are in bytes from the base
of the bank; the base addresses depend on the SoC and are in the `csr.csv` of a build.

| Configuration | Target and options |
|------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| `acorn_bench` | `acorn` `--with-serdes-debug` `--example` `bench` |
| `xcku3p_gen2_bench` | `alibaba_xcku3p` `--with-serdes-debug` `--example` `bench` `--gen2-capable` |

Access is `rw` for a register written by software (`CSRStorage`, or a `CSRStatus` that
software also writes, such as event pending bits cleared by writing 1), `ro` for a status
(`CSRStatus`) and `wo` for a write-only strobe (`CSR`). The reset value of a `CSRStorage`
register ends its description. A register wider than 32 bits takes several
32-bit words of the bus, most significant word first. The tools of `bench/` use these
names through the `csr.csv` of the build, so they rarely need the offsets.

## PHY debug {#reg-usb3-debug}

Defined by `USB3PHYDebug` (`usb3_pipe/debug.py`).

Bank `usb3_debug`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `phy_reset` | `0x0000` | 1 | rw | PHY (PIPE + LTSSM) reset (level). Reset `0x0`. |
| `serdes_rx_reset` | `0x0004` | 1 | rw | SerDes RX re-initialization (level). Reset `0x0`. |
| `clear` | `0x0008` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `status` | `0x000c` | 11 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `timestamp` | `0x0010` | 32 | ro | Timestamp (us). |
| `history_count` | `0x0014` | 32 | ro | Number of LTSSM state transitions. |
| `history_index` | `0x0018` | 5 | rw | History entry to read (0 = oldest). Reset `0x0`. |
| `history_state` | `0x001c` | 8 | ro | History entry state. |
| `history_time` | `0x0020` | 32 | ro | History entry timestamp (us). |
| `history_freeze` | `0x0024` | 1 | rw | Keep the first transitions after a clear (else the last ones). Reset `0x0`. |
| `history_u3_exit` | `0x0028` | 1 | rw | Write 1: restart the history on the next U3 exit (with history_freeze: the first transitions after the U3 exit are kept). Reset `0x0`. |
| `ts1_count` | `0x002c` | 32 | ro | ts1 events count (saturating). |
| `ts1_inv_count` | `0x0030` | 32 | ro | ts1_inv events count (saturating). |
| `ts2_count` | `0x0034` | 32 | ro | ts2 events count (saturating). |
| `lfps_polling_` `count` | `0x0038` | 32 | ro | lfps_polling events count (saturating). |
| `lfps_ping_count` | `0x003c` | 32 | ro | lfps_ping events count (saturating). |
| `lfps_exit_u1_` `count` | `0x0040` | 32 | ro | lfps_exit_u1 events count (saturating). |
| `lfps_exit_u2_` `count` | `0x0044` | 32 | ro | lfps_exit_u2 events count (saturating). |
| `lfps_wakeup_u3_` `count` | `0x0048` | 32 | ro | lfps_wakeup_u3 events count (saturating). |
| `lfps_reset_` `count` | `0x004c` | 32 | ro | lfps_reset events count (saturating). |
| `rx_idle_count` | `0x0050` | 32 | ro | rx_idle events count (saturating). |
| `rx_errors_` `cycles_count` | `0x0054` | 32 | ro | rx_errors_cycles cycles count (saturating). |
| `k28_4_count` | `0x0058` | 32 | ro | k28_4 cycles count (saturating). |
| `u0_count` | `0x005c` | 32 | ro | u0 events count (saturating). |
| `recovery_count` | `0x0060` | 32 | ro | recovery events count (saturating). |
| `u1_count` | `0x0064` | 32 | ro | u1 events count (saturating). |
| `u2_count` | `0x0068` | 32 | ro | u2 events count (saturating). |
| `u3_count` | `0x006c` | 32 | ro | u3 events count (saturating). |

Fields of `status`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `ltssm_state` | 7:0 | LTSSM state (get_ltssm_states). |
| `serdes_ready` | 8 | SerDes ready. |
| `rx_idle` | 9 | SerDes RX electrical idle. |
| `rx_polarity` | 10 | SerDes RX polarity inverted. |

## Device core status and traces {#reg-usb3-core}

Defined by `USB3DeviceCore.add_csr` (`usb3_core/device.py`).

Bank `usb3_core`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `trace_control` | `0x0000` | 8 | rw | See the fields below. Reset `0x1`. |
| `trace_count` | `0x0004` | 16 | ro | Recorded entries. |
| `trace_pointer` | `0x0008` | 16 | ro | Write pointer (circular: oldest entry). |
| `trace_index` | `0x000c` | 16 | rw | Entry to read. Reset `0x0`. |
| `trace_data` | `0x0010` | 64 | ro | Entry (dw1, type, direction, timestamp). |
| `link_trace_` `control` | `0x0018` | 8 | rw | See the fields below. Reset `0x1`. |
| `link_trace_` `count` | `0x001c` | 16 | ro | Recorded entries. |
| `link_trace_` `pointer` | `0x0020` | 16 | ro | Write pointer (circular: oldest entry). |
| `link_trace_` `index` | `0x0024` | 16 | rw | Entry to read. Reset `0x0`. |
| `link_trace_data` | `0x0028` | 96 | ro | Entry (timestamp, events, RX/TX Link Command and Header Packet fields, Recovery causes: see USB3LinkTrace). |
| `status` | `0x0034` | 15 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `rx_lbad` | `0x0038` | 16 | ro | LBAD sent (Header Packets RX errors). |
| `tx_retry` | `0x003c` | 16 | ro | LBAD received (Header Packets resent). |
| `recovery_req` | `0x0040` | 16 | ro | Recovery requests (timeouts, errors). |
| `link_state` | `0x0044` | 31 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `recovery_cause` | `0x0048` | 48 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `recovery_` `request` | `0x0050` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rx_errors` | `0x0054` | 32 | ro | See the fields below. |

Fields of `trace_control`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `enable` | 0 | Trace enable (stops when full). |
| `clear` | 1 | Trace clear (timestamp reset). |
| `circular` | 2 | Circular (stopped with enable=0). |
| `ept_filter` | 3 | Record only the ept endpoint packets. |
| `ept` | 7:4 | Endpoint number (ept_filter). |

Fields of `link_trace_control`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `enable` | 0 | Trace enable (stops when full). |
| `clear` | 1 | Trace clear (timestamp reset). |
| `circular` | 2 | Circular, stops on a U0 exit. |
| `filter` | 3 | Drop LUP/LDN only entries and ITPs. |
| `skip` | 7:4 | Circular: U0 exits/Recovery requests ignored before stopping. |

Fields of `status`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `ready` | 0 | U0, link initialized. |
| `configured` | 1 | Configured (SET_CONFIGURATION). |
| `address` | 14:8 | Device Address. |

Fields of `link_state`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `tx_seq` | 3:0 | Next Header Sequence Number to send. |
| `ack_seq` | 7:4 | Header Sequence Number expected in the next LGOOD_n. |
| `send_seq` | 11:8 | Header Sequence Number of the next Header Packet to retransmit. |
| `remote_credits` | 14:12 | Remote Type 1 Rx Header Buffer credits. |
| `remote_credits2` | 17:15 | Remote Type 2 Rx Header Buffer credits (SuperSpeedPlus). |
| `adv_received` | 18 | Header Sequence Number Advertisement received. |
| `pm_block` | 19 | LAU sent: no transmission until the next U0 entry. |
| `pm_accepted` | 20 | LGO_U1/LGO_U2 accepted: no new Header Packets until the next U0. |
| `tx_hp_valid` | 21 | Header Packet to send. |
| `tx_hp_ready` | 22 | Header Packet accepted. |
| `lrty_pending` | 23 | LRTY to send. |
| `lbad_wait` | 24 | LBAD sent, waiting for LRTY. |
| `ssp` | 25 | SuperSpeedPlus operation. |
| `tx_full` | 26 | Tx Header Buffers full. |
| `rx_seq` | 30:27 | Next Header Sequence Number expected. |

Fields of `recovery_cause`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `last` | 4:0 | Last Recovery cause: hp_seq, lgood, lcrd, pending_hp, credit_hp |
| `hp_seq` | 15:8 | hp_seq Recovery requests (saturating). |
| `lgood` | 23:16 | lgood Recovery requests (saturating). |
| `lcrd` | 31:24 | lcrd Recovery requests (saturating). |
| `pending_hp` | 39:32 | pending_hp Recovery requests (saturating). |
| `credit_hp` | 47:40 | credit_hp Recovery requests (saturating). |

Fields of `rx_errors`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `lc_bad` | 15:0 | Link Command words rejected (CRC-5/copies). |
| `dpp_bad` | 31:16 | DPPs received with a CRC-32 error. |

| `run` | 1 | Counting. |

## Gen 2 bring-up {#reg-usb3-gen2}

Defined by `add_usb3_gen2_rx` (`bench/usb3_soc.py`).

The snapshot banks share one interface: `arm` starts a capture, `trigger` selects
its stop condition, `done` tells when the buffer is full, then `index` selects an
entry and `data0` to `dataN` read it. [Debugging](#debugging) describes what each
snapshot holds.

Registers of the top-level `main` bank of the bench SoC.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `usb3_gen2_` `events` | `0x0000` | 160 | ro | In U0: ts_rx_ts1 (LTSSM), ts_rx_ts2, ts_rx_ts2_reset cycles, PHY Gen2RX TS1 blocks, monitor TS1 blocks. |
| `usb3_gen2_rx_` `link` | `0x0014` | 32 | ro | RX overflow [0], framing errors [31:16]. |
| `usb3_gen2_phy_` `rx_status` | `0x0018` | 8 | ro | PHY Gen 2 RX: aligned, locked, polarity, data_stream. |
| `usb3_gen2_lc_` `rearm` | `0x001c` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `usb3_gen2_lc_` `counts` | `0x0020` | 224 | ro | rx: LC framing, LC buffer written, entries written; sys: LC buffer read, entries read, LC Link Layer input, LC checked. |
| `usb3_gen2_` `txblocks_lbad` | `0x003c` | 1 | rw | TX Data Blocks snapshot also stopped on a LBAD received. Reset `0x0`. |
| `usb3_gen2_rx_` `lpmen` | `0x0040` | 1 | rw | RX equalizer: 1 LPM, 0 DFE. Reset `0x1`. |
| `usb3_gen2_link_` `max` | `0x0044` | 96 | ro | Max cycles: LGOOD pending, LCRD pending, DPP stall. |
| `usb3_gen2_link_` `max_clear` | `0x0050` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `usb3_gen2_` `capable` | `0x0054` | 1 | rw | Gen 2 capability advertised. Reset `0x1`. |
| `usb3_gen2_` `status` | `0x0058` | 2 | ro | Gen 2 negotiated [0], 10Gbps rate [1]. |

### `usb3_gen2_blocks_snapshot`

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `arm` | `0x0000` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `trigger` | `0x0004` | 2 | rw | Trigger: flags bit index. Reset `0x0`. |
| `done` | `0x0008` | 1 | ro | Capture done (triggered after arm, post-trigger entries stored). |
| `index` | `0x000c` | 9 | rw | Entry to read (0: oldest): the raw word then the flags, in data0..data4. Reset `0x0`. |
| `data0` | `0x0010` | 32 | ro | Entry bits [31:0]. |
| `data1` | `0x0014` | 32 | ro | Entry bits [63:32]. |
| `data2` | `0x0018` | 32 | ro | Entry bits [95:64]. |
| `data3` | `0x001c` | 32 | ro | Entry bits [127:96]. |
| `data4` | `0x0020` | 32 | ro | Entry bits [159:128]. |
